description.value: Hang Lee Wok is a fast-food Chinese restaurant located in Tsawwassen, BC. It offers indoor seating, giving cyclists a place to sit down and eat out of the elements after a ride through the South Delta area. The wok-centric name suggests a quick-service Chinese stir-fry menu.

All amenity and contact fields must therefore be null except where OSM tags provide direct, explicit evidence.
